subject: Vendor standup: account activation, PO flow & docs
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@velaris-systems.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@velaris-systems.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + ready to start vendor setup for Velaris

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Velaris is excited to get the account stood up so we can receive POs and start onboarding technical integrations. I wanted to surface our team and the initial docs we typically provide so we can move quickly.

Quick context: Velaris Systems is a mid-market SaaS vendor providing data adapter services. We expect to bill monthly; typical first PO should be for professional services.

What I can share now:
- W-9 (attached)
- Certificate of Insurance (attached)
- Bank information worksheet (attached; bank name, routing, acct)

Questions:
1) Is there a vendor portal for credentialing or is this routed via email?
2) What is Redwood's invoicing address and required invoice fields so our ops team can match POs?
3) Any preferred PO terms (PO number format, required fields, whether Net30 works)?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Samira Khan
Senior Finance Manager
Velaris Systems
attachments: Velaris_W9.pdf, Velaris_COI.pdf, Velaris_BANK_INFO.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@velaris-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com, procurement@velaris-systems.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + ready to start vendor setup for Velaris

Hi Samira — great to meet you earlier. Thanks for sending the initial docs. This thread will help capture exactly what we need from Velaris and what we will provide back to you to complete vendor activation.

What we need from you (please upload to the DocuSign link below or reply with attachments):
- Completed W-9 (PDF) — received, thank you; we will confirm tax name match to legal entity
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as a certificate holder (see required minimums below) — received, will validate coverage
- Banking details for ACH (bank name, routing, account, remittance contact) — received as worksheet; please complete bank authorization form if you prefer direct deposit
- Legal entity name, DBA (if applicable), registered address, and primary procurement contact
- Tax/VAT ID (if not in W-9) and any US state tax registrations if you will bill state taxes
- Completed Supplier Profile form (one-pager) — link below

What you can expect from Redwood:
- PO creation and outbound confirmation within 2 business days after vendor activation
- Standard Net30 terms unless otherwise negotiated; exceptions handled by Finance (cc'd)
- Invoice routing: invoices@redwood-inference.com; please include PO number, invoice date, line items, and billing address exactly as below
- Payment remittance advice email on payment date

Portal & next steps:
- Upload link / DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/Velaris/vendor-onboarding
- Supplier Profile form: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSupplierProfile
- Please confirm when you upload the signed banking authorizations so Finance can kick off ACH verification.

Insurance minimums (high-level):
- General Liability: $1M per occurrence
- Auto Liability: $1M combined
- Employers Liability: $500k
- Redwood Inference should be listed as additional insured only where services require it (we'll advise if needed)

I'll loop in Marissa from Procurement to cover the PO and invoice matching specifics. If anything here is problematic, flag and we'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Strategic Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0186

----
Note: Please sign the banking authorization before we enable ACH — instructions in the DocuSign packet.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@velaris-systems.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor standup: account activation, PO flow & docs

Thanks Neha — quick operational notes from Procurement so Samira knows how we'll process POs and invoices. Adding in-line items so it's easy to copy.

PO process (summary):
- PO issuance: Procurement will generate a PO in Coupa (or our internal PO system) and email a PDF PO to the vendor inbox; the PO number format is RW-YYYY-XXXXX (we'll provide first PO example).
- Required invoicing fields: PO number, invoice date, vendor legal name matching our vendor record, line-level descriptions, quantity/units, unit price, tax if applicable, remit-to name/address.
- Invoice submission: invoices@redwood-inference.com (PDF preferred). For EDI or SFTP-based invoice feeds, we can evaluate but require security review.
- Payment terms: default Net30. If you need Net45/60, please include that request on the Supplier Profile; Finance will review and create a contract amendment if approved.
- Early-pay / DP programs: Redwood uses a vendor financing partner for early pay; opt-in required via a separate agreement.

Vendor setup checklist (Procurement actions):
- Create vendor record in our system after W-9 match
- Verify COI meets minimums
- Complete bank verification (micro-deposit or ACH form)
- Assign vendor code and send welcome email with example PO and remittance instructions

Attachments: I attached a sample PO template and the Supplier Profile link (see below).

Sample PO link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=PO-sample-2027
Supplier Profile (fillable): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSupplierProfile

If anything is time-sensitive (e.g., month-end cutoffs), tell us and we'll prioritize activation on our next vendor intake run.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: RW_PO_template.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@velaris-systems.com>

Hi Neha / Marissa — thanks for the clear checklist and examples. I uploaded the signed bank authorization, W-9, and updated COI to the DocuSign packet and attached them here for convenience.

A couple quick items:
- We prefer ACH; signed authorization included.
- Our invoices will reference the PO number you send; please confirm the first PO number once created so our billing team can use it for the initial invoice.
- Portal credentials: is there a vendor portal login or should I expect a welcome email from procurement with vendor code and sample PO?

I'll watch for the welcome email and PO. If you want to run a short test invoice to validate remittance matching, we can send a one-line $1 test invoice once the vendor record is visible.

Attached: Velaris_W9.pdf, Velaris_COI.pdf, Velaris_BANK_INFO.xlsx

Best,
